verdict.rationale: Publishing source under an open license is a fair question for a fintech/stablecoin platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Paxos publishes its own source code or names a license. The only related mention, that USDG can be a building block for open-source smart contracts, describes third-party contracts built on top of USDG, not Paxos's own code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
